location_description: Mount Laurel is a township in Burlington County, New Jersey, United States, and is an edge city suburb of Philadelphia. As of the 2010 U.S. census, the township's population was 41,864, reflecting an increase of 1,643 (+4.1%) from the 40,221 counted in the 2000 census, which had in turn increased by 9,951 (+32.9%) from the 30,270 counted in the 1990 census. It is the home of NFL Films.
